meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: Claude会执行记忆迁移：先请求批准，然后列出受影响分组、暂停任务并停止容器，按规则移动或隔离 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等旧文件，整理进共享记忆树并更新索引，最后生成报告和验证结果。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate memory”“legacy memory”等触发词，或更新后报告共享记忆不兼容、分组内还有 .seed.md 等旧记忆文件时运行。

say.text: 帮我迁移旧记忆到共享记忆树。
say.note: 会开始检查受影响分组并请求批准。

say.text: 这个分组还有CLAUDE.md旧文件，请迁移。
say.note: 会将该文件按规则移动再整理。

say.text: 切换后它把什么都忘了，请迁移记忆。
say.note: 对应记忆丢失场景启动技能。

howto.what_en: Claude runs the legacy-memory migration: asks for approval, lists affected groups, pauses tasks and stops containers, then moves or quarantines legacy files (.seed.md, CLAUDE.md, etc.) per rules, organizes them into the shared memory tree, updates indexes, and finally produces a report and verifies.
howto.when_en: Runs when you say "migrate memory", "legacy memory", etc., or after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md/CLAUDE.md legacy files.

say_en.text: Help me migrate old memory to the shared memory tree.
say_en.note: Starts checking affected groups and asks for approval.

say_en.text: This group still has a legacy CLAUDE.md; please migrate it.
say_en.note: Moves and organizes it per migration rules.

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch; run memory migration.
say_en.note: Triggers the skill for the memory-loss case.
